title: Quick Fix Indian Chicken Butter Chicken Curry
description: A tangy and silky Udupi-inspired dish that combines chicken with a rich and creamy butter chicken sauce. This quick-fix recipe is a great weeknight option, ready in under an hour.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme in a large bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Melt the butter in the same skillet over medium heat. Add the tomato puree, heavy cream, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper. Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is fully coated.
Serve the butter chicken hot, garnished with cilantro and a dollop of raita if desired.
Steam the chicken in a papillote with the butter and spices for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Finely chop the cilantro and mix with yogurt, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper to make the raita. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Mix the tomato puree, heavy cream, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper in a bowl, then melt the butter and stir in the spice mixture.
Add the cooked chicken to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat, then serve hot.
